item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Crisp pork crackling with white potatoes, brown gravy and warm red cabbage, topped with parsley. With coarse French potato crisps and pickled gherkins. (1+6+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Peruvian Pollo a la Brasa – deliciously marinated, grilled chicken with roasted diced potatoes and oven-baked spiced red onion, topped with chopped parsley. With aji verde sauce, mayonesa casera and ensalada fresca. Gluten free. (2+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Peruvian Portobello a la Brasa – deliciously marinated, grilled portobello with roasted diced potatoes and oven-baked spiced red onion, topped with chopped parsley. With aji verde sauce, mayonesa casera and ensalada fresca. Gluten free. (2+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Christmas medister sausage with potatoes, red cabbage and brown gravy. (1+6+10+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mushroom roast with potatoes, red cabbage and a herb sauce with roasted nuts. (9+13+15) — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Fish of the day with braised fennel, a tapenade of olives and sun-dried tomato, and a blue mussel sauce with dill oil. (3+6+13+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Salt-baked celeriac with white beans, braised fennel, a tapenade of olives and sun-dried tomato, and a vegetable sauce with dill oil. (6+10+13+15) — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Caribbean marinated and crisp-fried saithe served with spiced coconut rice with kidney beans, topped with a fresh coleslaw with green beans. With chilli sauce, Caribbean remoulade, lime and tangy mango salsa. Also served gluten free. (1+2+3+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Caribbean marinated and crisp-fried tofu served with spiced coconut rice with kidney beans, topped with a fresh coleslaw with green beans. With chilli sauce, Caribbean remoulade, lime and tangy mango salsa. Also served gluten free. (1+2+7+11+15) — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
